notes.title: Oct 05 Dev Diary
notes.content:
Hello! This is June from JK Games.

Today, I will talk about our progress and heroes.

This week, we have achieved a total of 22 unique heroes, which was our early access goal.

These heroes are categorized into 5 different factions: Plains, Mountains, Forests, Good, and Evil. Among them, Plains, Mountains, and Forest factions each consist of 6 heroes, totaling 18, while the Good and Evil factions have 2 heroes each, making a total of 4 heroes. When combined, there are 22 heroes in total.

Factions serve as the primary classification for heroes. As their names suggest, heroes designed for Plains, Mountains, and Forest terrains have skills that make them excel in their respective environments. The Good and Evil factions are special and house rare heroes with even more powerful abilities.

Additionally, when you form a team with heroes of the same faction, you will receive teamwork bonuses! You can have a total of 5 heroes in a team, and if 3 or more of them belong to the same faction, you'll gain bonuses. However, it's important to note that there are clear advantages and disadvantages between factions, so forming a team with heroes of the same attribute might not always be the wisest choice.

Each hero comes with 3 skills that can be used with cooldowns and an ultimate ability that requires mana to use. A level 1 hero can use 1 skill and 1 ultimate ability, while a maximum level 3 hero can use 3 skills and 1 ultimate ability. In other words, higher-level heroes can adapt to a wider range of situations.

That's all for this week's update! Our goal for the next week is to create 10 items, 5 maps, 15 blessings, and 10 events to complete the game's content and work on balancing.

Thank you!

notes.title: First Post!
notes.content:
Hello! This is June from JK Games!

I'm delighted to announce that we're now able to start writing our first post. Going forward, we plan to provide regular updates summarizing our progress, among other things, once a week.

Here's the current status of the game:

[list]
[*] 15 unique heroes
[*] 5 items
[*] 4 maps
[*] 9 blessings
[*] 5 events
[/list]
Currently, we have set a release date for the game in mid-October. We will launch in Early Access with a total of 22 unique heroes, 10 items, 5 maps, 15 blessings, and 10 events.

We look forward to sharing more with you next week!
